title: Gather Spans Like writev
prompt: POSIX-flavored design. Given `struct span { const char *base; size_t len; };`, implement `size_t spans_total(const struct span *s, size_t n)` (sum of lens; NULL s with n>0 returns (size_t)-1) and `void spans_gather(const struct span *s, size_t n, char *out)` (concatenate the spans into out in order; assume out is large enough — but skip NULL bases).

tests.name: total and gather
tests.hint: Three buffers, one pass: gather reproduces the logical byte stream in order.

tests.name: empty list
tests.hint: n==0 means nothing to sum (0 is correct); NULL with n>0 is a contract violation.

tests.name: NULL base skipped
tests.hint: A NULL base contributes nothing to the output — the gather must skip, never dereference.
